description: This file defines a Java interface 'LinkConnector' for establishing and managing connections, which extends another interface 'LinkDecoder'. It also includes an anonymous implementation 'VOID' providing default no-op behaviors.

classes.name: LinkConnector
classes.description: An interface for managing connection lifecycle, sending commands, and error handling, extending the 'LinkDecoder' interface.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection and notifies the listener of connection state changes.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command string and optionally fires an event; may throw InterruptedException.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks whether the connector currently has an error state.
